final: WITH invoice_groups AS (SELECT invoice_number, 1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_groups) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_count, cost_ratio / average_ratio FROM invoice_groups CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (cost_ratio / average_ratio) IS NULL, cost_ratio / average_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
